headline: Trade persona fidelity for serving cost: {arm:f64} cuts cost but regresses on consistency.
lede: {arm:f64} saves cost over {arm:prod} while maintaining guardrails, but drops {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points on persona adherence. The choice turns on whether degradation in extended multi-turn dialogue is acceptable.

slots.text: {arm:f64} reduces cost from {cost_per_1k.prod|usd_per_1k} to {cost_per_1k.f64|usd_per_1k}, but persona adherence falls by {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points ({contrast.f64.persona.interval|interval}).
The switch flips to {arm:prod} if persona degradation greater than five points is unacceptable, or if conversations routinely exceed five turns.
Lean toward {arm:f64} if monthly serving budget is the primary constraint and prompt guardrails prevent major policy regressions.
A human side-by-side trial on long sessions or an explicit minimum acceptable persona fidelity threshold will settle the choice.

method.text: The evaluation ran {scoreboard.prod.cases} distinct dialogue cases across {scoreboard.prod.ran} total trials.
Graded by a calibrated judge rubric ({judge.agreement|pct} agreement on {judged.persona.calibration_ratings} human comparisons).
Requires music facts and non-speculation adherence on prompt bait tests to satisfy policy guardrails.
Reported intervals reflect {family.level} confidence on paired differences with {family.correction} family correction.
Token usage priced per thousand replies across varying context lengths over conversation turns.

flag.title: No target margin declared
flag.text: Because no explicit loss threshold was set in advance, the tradeoff between cost savings and persona drift requires product leadership judgment.

sections.headline: All candidates regress on persona adherence relative to {arm:prod}.
sections.takeaway: {arm:f64} drops {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points ({contrast.f64.persona.interval|interval}), while {arm:cor} shows smaller loss but breaches policy guardrails.
sections.caption: Intervals reflect {family.level} paired differences without multi-candidate correction.

sections.headline: Persona fidelity degrades steeply at deeper turns for Flash models.
sections.takeaway: While {arm:f64} is competitive in turns one and two, its adherence falls sharply past five turns.
sections.caption: Strata differences are descriptive and uncorrected.

sections.headline: Drift is concentrated in banter and corrections.
sections.takeaway: {arm:f64} holds persona well during song intros but struggles when receiving corrections or in banter.
sections.caption: Delta relative to control per scenario; uncorrected descriptive figures.

explore.recomputes: Adjusting valuation per persona point re-ranks {arm:prod} and {arm:f64}.

durable_claims.text: {arm:prod} achieves {judged.persona.prod|pct} persona adherence, exceeding {arm:f64} at {judged.persona.f64|pct} by {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points ({contrast.f64.persona.interval|interval}).
{arm:f64} costs {cost_per_1k.f64|usd_per_1k} and {arm:f16} costs {cost_per_1k.f16|usd_per_1k}, compared to {cost_per_1k.prod|usd_per_1k} for {arm:prod}.
{arm:cor} fails the speculation guardrail at {measure.specul.cor.mean|pct}, down {contrast.cor.specul.delta|abs|pts} points ({contrast.cor.specul.interval|interval}) relative to {arm:prod}.
